Name: TS3-MacOS-Plugin-StreamDeck
Author: Vini.Dev

Actions.Name: Counter
Actions.Tooltip: Displays a count, which increments by one on press.

Description: Native Stream Deck plugin for macOS that integrates with TeamSpeak 3 via ClientQuery. Control mic and speakers mute, toggle AFK mode, connect to bookmarks, and switch channels directly from your Stream Deck — no BarRaider, fully compatible and lightweight.
